title: God’s Covenant with David

questions.question: Who did David tell that he wanted to build a house for God?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 7:2 (ESV): "...the king said to Nathan the prophet, 'See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of God dwells in a tent.'"

questions.question: What did God promise to build for David?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 7:11 (ESV): "...Moreover, the LORD declares to you that the LORD will make you a house."

questions.question: Who did God say would build a house for His name?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 7:12-13 (ESV): "...I will raise up your offspring after you... He shall build a house for my name..."

questions.question: How long did God promise David's kingdom would be established?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 7:16 (ESV): "And your house and your kingdom shall be made sure forever before me. Your throne shall be established forever."

questions.question: What was David's response to God's message?
options: He went in and sat before the Lord and prayed
questions.correctAnswer: He went in and sat before the Lord and prayed
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 7:18 (ESV): "Then King David went in and sat before the LORD and said, 'Who am I, O Lord GOD... that you have brought me thus far?'"

questions.question: What did God say he took David from?
options: From the pasture, from following the sheep
questions.correctAnswer: From the pasture, from following the sheep
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 7:8 (ESV): "...I took you from the pasture, from following the sheep, that you should be prince over my people Israel."

questions.question: What relationship did God promise to have with David's son?
options: I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son
questions.correctAnswer: I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 7:14 (ESV): "I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son."

questions.question: God said He lived in a ______ and a ______.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 7:6 (ESV): "...but I have been moving about in a tent for my dwelling."

questions.question: David said God redeemed Israel from Egypt to be His people and to make a ______ for Himself.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 7:23 (ESV): "...whom God went to redeem to be his people, to make for himself a name..."

questions.question: God promised to appoint a place for Israel so they would be disturbed no more by whom?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 7:10 (ESV): "...so that the wicked shall not afflict them as formerly..."

questions.question: If David's son commits iniquity, how will God discipline him?
options: With the rod of men and the stripes of the sons of men
questions.correctAnswer: With the rod of men and the stripes of the sons of men
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 7:14 (ESV): "...When he commits iniquity, I will discipline him with the rod of men, with the stripes of the sons of men."

questions.question: Whose steadfast love did God say He would not take away from David's son?
options: As He took it from Saul
As He took it from Eli
As He took it from Adam
As He took it from Samson
questions.correctAnswer: As He took it from Saul
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 7:15 (ESV): "but my steadfast love will not depart from him, as I took it from Saul..."

questions.question: David asked God to confirm the word He had spoken concerning His servant and his house ______.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 7:25 (ESV): "...confirm forever the word that you have spoken..."

questions.question: David said, "For you, O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, have made this ______ to your servant."
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 7:27 (ESV): "...have made this revelation to your servant, saying, 'I will build you a house.'" (Hebrew: opened the ear)

questions.question: Who went out to speak to the people of Israel "judge" them (contextual prelude to chapter 8)?
questions.explanation: Note: This question is slightly out of context for Ch 7 but ensuring coverage. 7:7 mentions "judges of Israel". God asks "Did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel... saying, 'Why have you not built me a house of cedar?'"

key_verse_text: And your house and your kingdom shall be made sure forever before me. Your throne shall be established forever. (ESV)
